blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum inherent in high-gain lead playing.
Smooth out dynamics and provide controlled sustain for legato phrasing.
Provide subtle harmonic richness and controlled gain without sounding thick or crunchy.
blocks.gap: The tone requires more of a clean boost than distortion, but Red Haze offers controllable harmonics for fusion lead work. Keep it dialed back.
